topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cellular alterations drive clonal expansion and Darwinian selection during cancer development.

topics.label: Stem cell properties and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stem cell hierarchies, self-renewal capacity, and specific cells of origin influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental influences and inflammatory promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma permit tumor initiation and growth.

topics.label: Methods for investigating tumor evolution and microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the sequencing, imaging, and computational tools used to map clonal dynamics and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated multi-factorial model of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions converge to drive malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
